name: pricing-yearly-not-on-sale

anchor.name: What's included in a yearly membership?

text.contains: Yearly membership is coming soon and is not available to purchase yet

intent: A visitor on /pricing sees the yearly membership buy button in its disabled "Coming soon" state (the coming-soon test id is present and the live "Start membership" label is absent), and the FAQ "What's included in a yearly membership?" says plainly that it cannot be bought yet (no advertising ahead of shipping).
